claims.name: Offline static canonical publishing preflight
claims.before: No lane-owned runnable canonical-policy validator; 0 accepted cases in the frozen 32-case matrix.
claims.after: A read-only local validator classifies every frozen matrix case with expected exit and finding id, rejects missing/conflicting/mismatching canonical signals, and proves clean positive controls.
claims.limits: Explicit-head serialized static HTML only; policy comparison, not search-engine selection, JS rendering, HTTP headers, redirects, network freshness or publishing readiness.

interface.fileResolution: HTML paths relative to manifest directory; regular files only, reject symlinks and traversal; no network or writes in normal mode

outputs.stdout: JSON object with verdict, pagesChecked, findings array each containing id and page

interface.policy: Exactly one canonical link in explicit head per page, rel ASCII case-insensitive token list; resolve href with first head base href or document URL; compare WHATWG-like HTTP(S) normalized absolute URL to expectedCanonical, preserve query, reject fragments and credentials. HTMLParser stdlib limitations must be explicit. No automatic fetching, JS, or Google canonical selection claim.
